industrial_context: Air Production Unit compressor on an operational metro train
sampling_note: The UCI page contains inconsistent wording: its narrative says data were logged at 1 Hz, while its detailed attribute section describes 1,516,948 points at 0.1 Hz. The pipeline therefore measures the timestamp interval from the downloaded raw file instead of hard-coding a frequency.

raw_archive_sha256_reference.status: third-party reproducibility reference, not published by UCI

execution_note: The retained local workspace contains the official UCI archive and extracted CSV. No synthetic substitute was created. The included acquisition script downloads the official archive directly and records checksums when run in an internet-enabled environment; the bulk materialized files are excluded from the public Git payload.
